data.name: Triloki
data.long_meaning: Triloki is a name derived from Hindu mythology, meaning 'Three-eyed God'. This name signifies the divine Trimurti, the three primary aspects of God in Hinduism: Brahma, the creator; Vishnu, the preserver; and Shiva, the destroyer. The three eyes represent wisdom, knowledge, and inner vision.
